original_text: Looking for longitudinal plasma metabolomics cohorts in Alzheimer's disease, at least 200 patients, for biomarker validation. We want to minimise statin effects and need commercial-use rights.
scope_notes: Buyer needs a longitudinal plasma (not serum) cohort in Alzheimer's disease with at least 200 participants for biomarker validation work; statin co-medication is an explicit confounder concern, so cohorts that document and control for statin use are strongly preferred; commercial-use rights under the data access agreement are a hard requirement.

gaps.reason: No budget was stated; cost axis will be reported with open unknowns rather than a within-budget verdict.
No delivery deadline was stated; timeline per candidate will be reported but not compared against a target.
Request says 'metabolomics' but does not specify targeted vs. untargeted; both will be surfaced and the distinction flagged as a buyer decision point.
Request says 'Alzheimer's disease' only; cohorts enrolling MCI alongside AD (common in ADNI lineage) will be included with MCI status flagged as a soft concern.
